findings.evidence: `rg` finds `isPreconnected_cubeBoundary` only at line 33 and `eq_of_comp_eq` only at line 57, while the proof calls `hp.liftHomotopyRel` at line 111 and obtains boundary values from `QRel.apply_zero`, `QRel.apply_one`, and `QRel.prop`.
findings.fix: Rewrite lines 18–33 and 87–92 to explain the relative homotopy lift and that `Nontrivial N` supplies a remaining coordinate; remove the unused connectivity/uniqueness claims and `eq_of_comp_eq` reference.
findings.issue: The module docstring and `exists_map_eq` docstring claim surjectivity uses `isPreconnected_cubeBoundary` and uniqueness of lifts; the proof instead uses `liftHomotopyRel` to make the lift constant on the relative boundary. The references likewise list unused `eq_of_comp_eq`.

summary: The documentation describes a connectivity-and-uniqueness proof that the implementation does not use.
